author: The Infographics Show
description:
Mark Zuckerberg spent years making risky bets with almost total control over Meta. Now those decisions are starting to catch up with him.
This video examines how Zuckerberg lost more than $70 billion through Meta’s failed Metaverse push, why Facebook is losing relevance with younger users, and how his newest obsession with artificial intelligence may be creating an even bigger problem. Facebook and Instagram are increasingly flooded with AI-generated slop, fake engagement, automated accounts, and bizarre synthetic content designed to exploit the recommendation algorithm.

At the same time, Meta is spending well over $100 billion a year on AI infrastructure while cutting thousands of jobs and pushing controversial tools that users repeatedly reject. The company may still be worth more than a trillion dollars, but its core social platforms are becoming less human by the day.

title: Zuckerberg's actions finally have consequences...
